statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Current Tail remains below WATCH while NQ is weekend-closed; extreme Stress reflects unresolved Gulf energy-route disruption and reopening-gap risk.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The next material checkpoint is the Sunday Globex reopen, where actual retracement quality, repeated extension and cross-asset alignment can change Tail quickly.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while Gulf disruption keeps Stress extreme
body: NQ is closed, so current one-way price-path evidence is unavailable. Saudi Arabia's benchmark fell 1.0% and Aramco 1.1% in Sunday trading after attacks on the East-West pipeline, while a vessel was struck in the Strait of Hormuz. These developments sustain extreme event and gap Stress without yet proving persistent NQ mean-reversion failure.
